$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts' (open decision 2 there: whether outbound and sdr stay two packs). outbound finds companies and contacts; sdr runs the pipeline to the CRM through its provider contract.
title: leads/1
description: Companies worth contacting and the people in them, each with where it was found and the evidence it fits. outbound writes it; sdr reads it.
x-rules: A lead without evidence is not published.
A lead_id is stable: the same company has the same id in every document, so sdr does not contact it twice.
A contact's details are what the source published; nothing is guessed or inferred into them.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

leads.description: The leads; empty when none was found.

lead_id.description: Unique and stable for the company.

domain.description: Its website's domain, without a scheme.

country.description: Its country, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

contacts.description: The people found in it; empty when none was.

source.description: Where the lead was found (the tool, list or page).

source_url.description: The page it was found on, when there is one.

found_on.description: The day it was found, YYYY-MM-DD.

evidence.description: Why it fits, in one or two sentences a person can check against the source.
